tooEasy.title: Questions may be too easy

competency.name: A clear, concise name that describes the competency. Use action-oriented language (e.g., 'Strategic Decision Making').
competency.description: Detailed explanation of what this competency measures and its importance. Include observable behaviors and outcomes.
competency.category: Group competencies by domain to organize your competency framework. Categories help filter and search.
competency.level: The expected proficiency level: Novice → Proficient → Advanced → Expert. This helps set appropriate expectations.
competency.isActive: Active competencies are visible in assessments. Inactive ones are hidden but preserved for historical data.
competency.approvalStatus: Track the review lifecycle: Draft → Pending Review → Approved. Only approved competencies can be used in official assessments.

indicator.title: A specific, observable behavior that demonstrates this competency. Be concrete and measurable.
indicator.description: Additional context about what this indicator measures and how to identify it in practice.
indicator.weight: Relative importance (0-1) of this indicator. All weights for a competency should sum to 1.0.
indicator.observabilityLevel: How easily this behavior can be observed in typical work situations.
indicator.measurementType: The method used to assess this indicator (e.g., self-assessment, peer review, manager evaluation).
indicator.examples: Concrete examples of behaviors that demonstrate this indicator. These guide assessors.
indicator.counterExamples: Behaviors that indicate lack of this competency. Helps avoid common misconceptions.

question.questionText: The question presented to respondents. Be clear, specific, and avoid double-barreled questions.
question.questionType: How respondents will answer: Multiple Choice (one answer), Multi-Select (many answers), Scale (rating), or Open-ended.
question.answerOptions: Possible responses with their point values. For scales, define the anchors clearly.
question.difficultyLevel: Foundational → Intermediate → Advanced → Specialized. Affects scoring and test composition.
question.scoringRubric: Guidelines for scoring responses, especially for open-ended questions.
question.timeLimit: Optional time limit in seconds. Leave empty for untimed questions.
question.contextTags: Tags enable context filtering for different assessment scenarios. Add 'GENERAL' for Universal Baseline (Scenario A) assessments.

traits.openness: Openness to Experience: Creativity, curiosity, intellectual interests, and willingness to embrace new ideas.
traits.conscientiousness: Conscientiousness: Self-discipline, organization, goal-directed behavior, and reliability.
traits.extraversion: Extraversion: Sociability, assertiveness, positive emotions, and tendency to seek stimulation.

difficulty.title: Question Difficulty Level
difficulty.description: Controls the complexity of situational judgment scenarios presented to candidates.
difficulty.basic: Entry-level questions suitable for early-career candidates or foundational skill assessment.
difficulty.intermediate: Standard complexity appropriate for most professional roles and mid-career candidates.
difficulty.advanced: Senior-level scenarios requiring strategic thinking, complex problem-solving, and leadership judgment.

estimation.questions: Question count is estimated based on: selected competencies × average indicators × questions per indicator.
estimation.duration: Duration is calculated at approximately 30 seconds per question, including reading and response time.

jobFit.onetRole: O*NET (Occupational Information Network) occupation codes define standardized job competency requirements based on extensive labor market research.
jobFit.benchmark: The benchmark shows competencies and proficiency levels required for the selected job role, as defined by O*NET occupational data.
jobFit.deltaTesting: Delta testing identifies and focuses only on the gaps between a candidate's existing competency passport and job requirements, reducing assessment length.
jobFit.passport: A Competency Passport is a candidate's aggregated record of previously measured competencies from past assessments. When delta testing is enabled, the system reuses existing scores and skips already-measured competencies, making the assessment shorter and more focused.
jobFit.passportDesc: Reuse previous assessment results to shorten future tests
jobFit.deltaEnabled: When a candidate with a valid passport takes this test, already-measured competencies will be skipped automatically.
jobFit.deltaDisabled: All competencies will be assessed regardless of prior results.
jobFit.enableDeltaDesc: Skip competencies already measured in the candidate's passport

strictness.title: Benchmark Matching Strictness
strictness.description: Controls how closely a candidate must match the job benchmark to be considered a good fit.
strictness.lenient: Broader candidate pool: Accepts partial competency matches, suitable for entry-level hiring or talent development.
strictness.moderate: Balanced approach: Reasonable match requirements suitable for most standard hiring needs.
strictness.standard: Industry-typical requirements: Matches common hiring standards for professional roles.
strictness.strict: High bar: Only strong matches qualify, suitable for specialized or senior positions.
strictness.exact: Precise alignment: Requires near-perfect benchmark match, for critical roles with no room for skill gaps.

teamFit.team: Select the team to analyze for current skill coverage and identify competency gaps that new candidates should fill.
teamFit.assessment: Team Fit assessment focuses on undersaturated competencies, evaluating candidates on their ability to fill specific team skill gaps.

saturation.title: Skill Saturation Threshold
saturation.description: The minimum team coverage level for a skill before it is flagged as a gap.
saturation.threshold: Skills with team coverage below this percentage are considered undersaturated and will be prioritized in candidate assessment.

gapStatus.full: Skill fully covered: 90%+ team saturation indicates strong existing capability.
gapStatus.adequate: Skill adequately covered: Above threshold, no immediate hiring need for this competency.
gapStatus.gap: Skill gap detected: Below threshold, candidates with this skill would strengthen the team.
gapStatus.critical: Critical gap: Significantly below threshold, high priority for new hire skill requirements.
